typical_symptoms: Small circular brown spots appearing on mature leaves
Distinct concentric rings within lesions producing a target-board pattern
Yellow chlorotic halos surrounding individual leaf lesions
Coalescence of expanding lesions into large necrotic blighted areas
Premature leaf senescence and severe defoliation starting from the lower canopy
visual_characteristics: Prominent target-board concentric rings inside leaf spots
Tan to light brown dry necrotic centers
Dark reddish-brown to purple lesion margins
Bright yellow chlorotic halo band surrounding active spots
lesion_characteristics: Irregular shapes when multiple spots merge
Size ranging from 2 mm to over 15 mm in diameter
color_characteristics: Progression to tan or greyish-brown necrotic centers
texture_characteristics: Slightly rough center due to fungal sporulation under humid conditions
spatial_patterns: Concentric circular rings inside single spots
Randomly scattered spots across the leaf blade
Coalescing into extensive irregular necrotic patches
distinguishing_features: Classic target-board concentric rings within brown spots
Strong contrast between dark reddish border, tan center, and yellow halo
Heavy association with potassium-stressed plants and mature lower canopy leaves
